name: deck-kit
description: Offline HTML presentation kit and repository template with portable agent skills, presenter view, clicker control, PDF export and single-file builds

scripts.build:example: vite build --mode example && vite build --mode example-single && vite build --mode example-crypto && vite build --mode example-crypto-single
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && pnpm build:single && pnpm build:example && playwright test
scripts.test:engine: pnpm build && pnpm build:single && pnpm build:example && playwright test --project "engine-*"
scripts.test:deck: pnpm build && pnpm build:single && pnpm build:example && playwright test --project deck-chromium
scripts.media: pnpm build && pnpm build:example && node scripts/media.ts
